pet_notes: Cute full-body chibi human boy faithfully inspired by the provided portrait: fluffy short black side-swept hair, black browline rounded-rectangular glasses with clear lenses, warm fair skin, soft shy smile, tiny rosy cheeks. Oversized head about half total height, small rounded hands and short legs. Navy blue crew-neck raglan T-shirt with muted sage-gray sleeves matching the portrait, navy trousers and simple ivory sneakers. Neutral symmetrical outfit without lettering or logos. No bouquet or other props so hand gestures remain legible. Preserve recognizable hair, face and glasses across all frames.
style_notes: Adorable smooth matte vinyl collectible figure, soft rounded forms, clean sophisticated pastel shading, expressive face readable at tiny desktop size. Front three-quarter view, whole body with safe padding, no floor shadow, no scenery.
